name: DIMFE call for projects

funder.name: Donors' Initiative for Mediterranean Freshwater Ecosystems (DIMFE)

administered_by.name: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

summary: Annual call funding EUR 100,000 to 500,000 for field-based conservation and restoration of Mediterranean freshwater ecosystems, open to NGOs, local authorities and others; research-only projects are excluded. Above EUR 300,000, 25% cash co-financing is mandatory.

eligibility.rule: Start between March and June 2027 and last no more than 3 years
Have a clearly defined primary environmental objective
Not a WASH project (drinking water, sanitation, waste management or hygiene)
Private companies work in the ecological transition and have fewer than 20 employees
Keep studies or research from being the majority of activities
Include tangible actions beyond communication or awareness-raising
Have clearly identified, predominantly field-based implementation
Not led by a single individual

documents: Official Gazette publication or KBIS extract
List of Board of Directors members
Activity report for the previous year
Previous year's net profit account and statement of account, if not in the activity report
Organisation's estimated budget for the current year
Project budget workbooks in XLS: overall, and by objectives and activities

status.quote: The completed application form and both correctly filled-in budget tables must be submitted by October 15, 2026

deadline.quote: The completed application form and both correctly filled-in budget tables must be submitted by October 15, 2026

administered_by.quote: Fondation Prince Albert II de Monaco (coordinator of the Donors' Initiative for Mediterranean Freshwater Ecosystems)

applicant_types.quote: NGOs, local authorities, municipalities, private companies engaged in the ecological transition with less than 20 employees, scientific institutions.

geography.quote: Projects must be located within the Mediterranean basin, without geographical preference.

eligibility.quote: Projects must start between March and June 2027 and have a maximum duration of 3 years
Projects must have a clearly defined primary environmental objective.
WASH projects (water, sanitation, hygiene), including those focused on access to drinking water, sanitation infrastructure, waste management, or hygiene promotion
NGOs, local authorities, municipalities, private companies engaged in the ecological transition with less than 20 employees, scientific institutions.
Projects in which the majority of activities consist of studies or research
Projects focused solely on communication or awareness-raising, without tangible actions
Projects without clearly identified and predominantly field-based implementation
Projects led by a single individual

co_finance.quote: If the request for funding exceeds €300,000, 25% co-financing (non-in-kind) is mandatory.

after_award.quote: Interim instalments (30%) are paid at the end of each project year, after approval of the interim report 3. The last instalment (10%) is paid once the project has been completed, after approval of the final report
